description: Versification tables behind @lectio/refs (L-006, Greek Esther L-049): chapter and verse counts and cross-versification mappings. Numbers only; no Bible text.

sources.name: SIL libpalaso versification files (Paratext standard versifications)

files.notes: BHS for the Old Testament, UBS GNT / Nestle-Aland for the New; Greek-only material in separate books (S3Y, SUS, BEL, LJE, ESG). The original scheme lays the NABRE lettered chapters of Esther (A-F) on ESG: A = 1:1-17, B = 3:14-20, C = 4:18-47, D = 5:1-16, E = 8:13-36, F = 10:4-14 (L-049).

Stuttgart Vulgate numbering, with Clementine / Douay-Rheims chapter divisions (Joel 3 chapters, Malachi 4). Not the Nova Vulgata, which follows the Hebrew chapter divisions outside the Psalms. Psalms 115 and 147 are numbered from verses 10 and 12. Upstream gives no mapping for Tobit, Judith, Sirach or Esther.
Rahlfs Septuagint: Greek Daniel (DAG), Greek Esther (ESG), Ezra-Nehemiah as one book (EZR 1-23).

English Bibles (KJV/RSV tradition): psalm titles not counted as verses, Joel 2:28-32, Malachi 4. Its ESG lines (the integrated Greek Esther onto Rahlfs's lettered sub-verses, e.g. ESG 4:29 = ESG 4:17k) give greekEstherLxx the Rahlfs verse of each verse of the NABRE lettered chapters (L-049).

sources.name: Lectio supplements to the libpalaso mappings

files.notes: Jonah follows vul.vrs's own chapter table (Hebrew division, 1:16 2:11) instead of its mapping lines, which assume the English division. Psalms 115:1-9 and 147:1-11 are excluded, because vul.vrs numbers those psalms from verses 10 and 12. Esther (L-049): the Stuttgart (VUL83) chapter table that vul.vrs gives in a comment (Clementine / Douay-Rheims chapters 1-16, the Greek additions as 10:4-16:24) replaces its Nova Vulgata EST line, and the additions are mapped onto org.vrs ESG following STEPBible TVTMS (source stepbible-tvtms).
Maps the Greek additions in DAG 3:24-90 onto S3Y, as vul.vrs does for DAN.
Maps Catholic English Daniel (eng.vrs DAG, 14 chapters) onto org.vrs, combining eng.vrs's DAN shifts with vul.vrs's mapping of the additions.

sources.name: STEPBible TVTMS: Translators Versification Traditions with Methodology for Standardisation

sources.notes: Not embedded. The Esther sections ($Est.1:1-22, 3:1-14, 4:1-17, 5:1-14, 8:1-17, 10:1-3) give, verse by verse, the NABRE lettered chapters (column "Latin": A:1-17 ... F:1-11) against the Vulgate chapters 10:4-16:24 (column "Latin2"): A:1-11 = 11:2-12, A:12-17 = 12:1-6, B = 13:1-7, C:1-11 = 13:8-18, C:12-30 = 14:1-19, D:1 = 15:1-4, D:2-16 = 15:5-19, E = 16:1-24, F:1-10 = 10:4-13, F:11 = 11:1. vul.supplement.vrs writes these as mapping lines onto org.vrs ESG.
